The root cause: the frontend `api.ts` was calling endpoints that don't exist on the backend. The backend `features_router` (mounted at `/api/features`) expects:
- `GET /api/features?space_id=` — not `/api/spaces/{id}/features`
- `PATCH /api/features/{id}/feature-state` with `{feature_state}` — not `/api/tasks/{id}/feature-state` with `{state}`
- `POST /api/features` with `{space_id, title, type, brief}` — not `/api/spaces/{id}/features` with `{description}`

MEMORY[fact]: Features page 404 root cause was a frontend/backend route mismatch in `frontend/src/api.ts`. Backend `features_router` (backend/app/api/features.py) is mounted at `/api/features`: `GET /api/features?space_id=`, `PATCH /api/features/{id}/feature-state` with body `{feature_state}`, `POST /api/features` with body `{space_id,title,type,brief}`. The frontend was calling `/api/spaces/{id}/features` and `/api/tasks/{id}/feature-state`. Fixed all three `api.ts` functions (`features`, `transitionFeatureState`, `createFeature`); hooks/components unchanged. 24 feature tests + build pass.
